title: Build worker work-history surface
goal: Let a worker view their completed/upcoming job history with attendance and evaluation state, per SIM-20260922-WORK-004.

in: Identify existing worker shift/history data sources
out: Creating new tracking data where canonical sources exist

acceptance_criteria.criterion: SIM-20260922-WORK-004 reruns and passes with receiving-side evidence

evidence: Wave 34 re-run: 43 test files / 231 tests pass across __tests__/jobs/ + __tests__/hiring/ + __tests__/work-mode/, which includes the 8 work-mode history tests (5 read-model + 3 route contract) unchanged.

Read-model evidence re-confirmed by reading lib/work-mode/read-model.ts: the assignment read is server-side scoped eq(user_id, userId); the check-in/out read is inside `if (workerActionsAvailable && knownRows.length > 0)`; a failed metric read sets availability.events = 'unavailable' and a failed attendance read warns and degrades rather than throwing.

The timed-attendance relation work_mode_check_in_events is created by the active chain (20260922155356_worker_actions_scope_reconciliation.sql) but absent from lib/database.types.ts, so the read goes through a documented `as SupabaseClient<Database> & { from(table: "work_mode_check_in_events"): any }` escape at lib/work-mode/read-model.ts:806-812. It is one of only two chain-created relations missing from the generated contract in the whole DB-008 inventory; only a database-lane regeneration can clear it. Handed off as HF-WORK-034-WORKER-ACTIONS-TYPE-SURFACE.
No code change was made to the history surface this round; no migration, no hosted action, no feature-flag change.
Transferred from the v1 task; this gate does not keep a locally complete domain implementation active.

progress.summary: Implemented and locally re-verified: the worker work-history surface (server-side read model getWorkModeHistory, GET /api/work-mode/history, the History view in the workspace, and a self-contained client component with loading/error/empty/upcoming/past states) reusing canonical staff_shifts + staff_performance_metrics, with timed attendance gated on FEATURE_WORK_MODE_WORKER_ACTIONS=1. Wave 34 added no code change but did establish why the gate cannot be lifted from this lane: work_mode_check_in_events is chain-created yet missing from the generated contract, which is a database-lane reconciliation, not a work-lane edit. Acceptance (SIM-20260922-WORK-004 rerun with receiving-side evidence) still requires hosted staging, so the task stays active.

- filters employment_assignments to active + terminal statuses (completed/cancelled/declined now visible)

- attendance from staff_shifts.status, or gated work_mode_check_in_events when FEATURE_WORK_MODE_WORKER_ACTIONS=1
- buckets upcoming (asc) and completed (desc); fails closed on assignment read error
Add GET /api/work-mode/history route (401 not_authenticated, 503 unavailable, Cache-Control private no-store; only ever calls the read model with the authenticated user id)
Add History view ({ id: history, label: History }) to WORK_MODE_VIEWS as the canonical last nav item; contract strings for overview preserved

Add 8 focused tests: 5 read-model unit tests (scoping, bucketing, gating off/on, empty evaluation, fail-closed) + 3 route contract tests (401/200/503)
next_steps: Follow the linked product verification gate; do not reopen this record.
blockers: Acceptance criterion needs hosted staging evidence (RELEASE-007/QA gates pending); not runnable this round, task stays active

DB-010 work_mode_check_in_events schema/RLS not applied hosted; timed attendance read is gated on FEATURE_WORK_MODE_WORKER_ACTIONS=1 with fallback to shift status. The relation is in the active chain but not in the generated contract (HF-WORK-034-WORKER-ACTIONS-TYPE-SURFACE to the database lane).

checkpoints.summary: Re-verified the worker work-history surface this round with no code change: the server-side scoping, the FEATURE_WORK_MODE_WORKER_ACTIONS=1 attendance gate, the empty/evaluation/fail-closed states and the route's 401/200/503 contract all still pass. Two durable findings recorded: the timed-attendance read reaches work_mode_check_in_events through a documented local any-escape because the relation IS created by the active chain (20260922155356) but missing from the generated contract - it is one of only two such objects in the whole DB-008 inventory and only a database-lane regeneration can fix it (HF-WORK-034-WORKER-ACTIONS-TYPE-SURFACE); and the worker-action route uses the request-scoped client only, never a service-role client, so worker mutations stay inside RLS.
